_doc: Qarabağ (0.19.0, the big map): 4.9 km of two-lane mountain asphalt through summer forest. control: [x, y, z, full_width, theme 4 = forest]. North = -z, east = +x. Xankəndi (north-east, y 12): start straight heading west; the climb (max grade 7.9 %) to the Şuşa plateau (centre-north, y 44); the descent west to Laçın on the Həkəri (y 20); south down the Həkəri valley to the Araz (y 2); east along the Araz bank past the Xudafərin bridges; north through forest hills back to Xankəndi. Tightest bend r 18 m, distant legs >= 95 m apart. No sea. zones: [id, x, z, radius] town / sight areas (open ground, no closed forest); landmark_plots: [x, z, radius, zone] kept free for the Blender landmarks; rivers: polylines [x, z] with a width (Blender terrain + water ribbons).
